description: A Footer for mobile totals and an Aside for desktop summaries.

page.title: Transaction Summary
page.description: A Footer for mobile totals and an Aside for desktop summaries.

whenToUse.title: When to use
items: Use **Transaction Footer** on mobile payment screens.
Use **Transaction Summary** in the side column of desktop payment screens.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.text: The value block is ordered as optional `mainItem`, optional `details`, and required `total`. The optional `notice` is separate from that block, and `action` is required.

content.title: Content
items: Rows contain `label`, `value`, and optional `info` on a second line below the value. Keep icons, descriptions, captions, tags, and struck-through values out of rows.
Use no more than four details as a screen-level rule; the components render every detail received.
In normal use, always pass a Summary title, such as **Payment summary**. Leaving it out is an exception.
The notice description is required; its title and icon are optional. The recommended solid check-circle icon stays vertically centered with or without a title.

behavior.title: Behavior
items: The body or card overlaps the separate notice.
Dividers appear only between existing rows and before the total when a row precedes it.
Main item and details are independent; the first detail is never promoted to main.

tokens.title: Tokens and colors
tokens.text: Use Ocean tokens for surfaces, text, dividers, spacing, and radius. Notice colors remain fixed values outside the token system intentionally.
rows: Divider|colorInterfaceLightDown|Footer Default top border and row dividers

typography.title: Typography
typography.text: Row labels use Regular 14 and values use SemiBold 14. Optional info follows the Transaction List amount.info style: captionbold with $font-size-xxxs, $font-weight-medium, $line-height-comfy, and $color-interface-dark-down; keep $spacing-inline-xxxs between the value and info. Total label and value use Bold 16; notice title uses ExtraBold 14 and description Regular 12.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.text: Use 8px between the notice icon and text, 4px between notice title and description, 8px of vertical padding around details, and 16px for the notice overlap and action spacing.

structure.title: Structure
structure.footerText: The notice sits above the body. Its solid 20 × 20 check-circle stays vertically centered with or without a title. Default has a 1px top border on the body; Highlight has 12px top corners on the body. The root has no background.
structure.summaryText: The light-up card with 12px radius sits above the notice. The optional title appears only when passed, and the required action stays outside the card.

requirements.title: Requirements
items: Keep row labels and values in a meaningful reading order.
The notice description remains available as text when its icon is hidden.
Treat the decorative default notice icon as hidden from assistive technology.
